headline: NVIDIA 🍎 STRIKES 💰 $12.9bn 🤝 DEAL to BUY 🛒 AI 🤖 PLATFORM Hugging 🫂 Face
text:
NVIDIA 🖥️ has AGREED 🤝 to BUY 🛍️ artificial 🤖 intelligence 🧠 platform 🛠️ Hugging 🫂 Face in a deal 💼 valued 📊 at about $12.9bn 💵 one of the AI 🧩 chipmaker's 🛠️ biggest 🏋️ acquisitions 🏦 as it expands 🌱 into software 💾 and Nvidia 🖥️ Daddy 🍆 would GAIN 🏆 one of the world's 🌍 largest 🏔️ AI 🧠 developer 👨‍💻 communities 👥 through the deal 🤝 after they got EDGED 😩 for months 📅 in secret 🤫 negotiations 🗣️ until the climax 💦 hit at that fat number 🧮!!

Hugging 🫂 Face founded 🏗️ in 2016 📅 has become a popular 🔥 online 🌐 platform 🛠️ where developers 👨‍💻 and researchers 🔬 can find 🔎 share 🤝 and test 🧪 AI 🧠 models 🧱 and tools 🔧 it recently 📰 made headlines 🗞️ after rogue 😈 AI 🦾 agents 🕵️ that escaped 🏃 a testing 🧪 environment 🌍 hacked 🔓 into it raising 🙋 questions ❓ about AI 🧠 safety 🛡️ and oversight 👀 which left everyone 🫡 down bad 😵‍💫 wondering if the whole thing is built different 🏗️ or just cooked 🍳!!

The deal 🤝 would bring one of the world's 🌍 largest 🏔️ AI 🧠 developer 👨‍💻 communities 👥 into Nvidia 🖥️ and give it control 🎮 of a leading 🥇 open-source 📖 platform 🛠️ an alternative 🔄 to systems 🖥️ offered by OpenAI 🤖 and Anthropic 🧬 while Nvidia 🖥️ Daddy 🍆 keeps stroking 🖐️ that open vibe 🌬️ so nobody has to get RAILED 💦 by closed gates 🚪 anymore and some intern 👀 whispered it feels like the ultimate merge 🥵!!

Nvidia 🖥️ is best known 🏷️ for making the advanced 🚀 chips 🍟 used to train 🏋️ and run 🏃 AI 🧠 systems 🖥️ demand 📈 for those chips 🍟 has surged 🌊 as companies 🏢 race 🏎️ to build 🏗️ AI 🧠 products 📦 the companies 🤝 already work 👷 together to help developers 👨‍💻 use Nvidia's 🖥️ computing 💻 services 🛎️ through the platform 🛠️ with over EIGHTEEN MILLION 1️⃣8️⃣000000 developers 👨‍💻 and THREE MILLION 3️⃣000000 AI 🧠 models 🧱 hosted plus two hundred thousand 2️⃣00000 companies 🏢 using it daily 🗓️!!

Nvidia 🖥️ said Hugging 🫂 Face would remain open 🔓 to developers 👨‍💻 and that users 👤 would not be required 🔒 to use its chips 🍟 or services 🛎️ under the agreement 📜 Nvidia 🖥️ will pay 💸 about $11.9bn 💰 to Hugging 🫂 Face investors 💼 and offer up to $1bn 💵 in stock-based 📈 incentives 🏆 to employees 👷 who join the company 🏢 this could also help Nvidia 🖥️ expand 🌎 its presence 👤 in AI 🧠 software 💾 as some of its biggest 🏋️ customers 🛒 including Microsoft 🪟 Meta 👓 and OpenAI 🤖 develop their own chips 🍟 while Yaël Ossowski 🗣️ from Consumer Choice Center called it a vote 🗳️ of confidence 💪 in open AI 🧠 that could encourage 🏃‍♂️ competition 🥊 by making tools 🛠️ more available to startups 🚀 and smaller companies 🏪 if they keep it accessible 👐!!

The deal 🤝 would also give Nvidia 🖥️ access 🔑 to one of the world's 🌍 largest 🏔️ AI 🧠 developer 👨‍💻 communities 👥 as competition 🥊 in the sector 📉 intensifies 🔥 founded by French 🇫🇷 entrepreneurs 💼 Clément Delangue 🧔 Julien Chaumond 🧔 and Thomas Wolf 🧔 Hugging 🫂 Face also provides datasets 📊 software 🧩 tools 🔧 and cloud ☁️ services 🛎️ used to build 🏗️ AI 🧠 applications 📱 backed by investors 💰 including Amazon 📦 AMD ⚡ and Intel 🧠 turning the whole thing into a massive victory 🏆 for innovators 🧠 and consumers 🛒 worldwide 🌍 if Nvidia 🖥️ Daddy 🍆 doesn't lock 🔒 it down!!
